# Booqy build contracts (Runs 1-3)

The fixed contract every feature agent implements against. Written in Run 0
step 4 from ADR-A..J, RULES.md and EXPLORE-NOTES.md; extended in the Run 0
addendum (branch `build/run-0-addendum-kl`) with features K (events and
tickets, ADR-K) and L (AI phone agent, ADR-L). Where this file and an
ADR disagree, **this file wins**; report the mismatch to the orchestrator.
Addendum rows are marked "(addendum)"; section 17 lists exactly what
`application/contracts/booqy.yaml` must gain for them. Anything marked
**[NEEDS YOUR OK]** is an owner decision still open (pricing, plans,
legal wording, retention) and ships with the safe placeholder shown.
A feature agent that finds the contract wrong stops and reports it
(RULES.md, Scope); it never changes a shared file itself.

Conventions used below:

- `<prefix>` = `""` in prod, `"<env>-"` elsewhere (Terraform
  `local.prefix`), so `<prefix>meta-ads` is `dev-meta-ads` in dev.
- `<env>` = `dev` | `prod` (Terraform `var.env`).
- Amounts in öre are integers; `...Sek` fields are whole kronor.
- Ids marked "client ULID" are generated by the client and make the call
  idempotent (conditional Put, retry returns the stored result).
- Dates `yyyy-mm-dd`, months `yyyy-mm`, times ISO 8601 UTC with `Z`.

entitlement key is camelCase; the Python package is the snake form).

## 1. Contract source and generated types

**Decision: one YAML file, `application/contracts/booqy.yaml`**, read by
`application/scripts/gen_contracts.py`. YAML (not JSON Schema) because the
content is small lists and flat field maps, it diffs well, and PyYAML is
already installed (pulled in by `openapi-spec-validator`; Run 0 lists it in
`requirements-dev.txt` explicitly). Request/response bodies are NOT in it;
they live in OpenAPI fragments (section 15).

### 1.1 What the YAML holds (Run 0, complete for Runs 1-3)

| Section | Content |
|---|---|
| `features` | all 18 entitlement keys in display order (16 from Run 0, `events` and `phoneAgent` from the addendum): `key`, `id` (kebab), `labelSv`, `labelEn`, `existing` (bool), `siteConfig` (bool: exposed in `/site-config`) |
| `limits` | `siteBuilderAiEditsPerMonth`: `feature: siteBuilder`, `type: int`, `min: 0`, `max: 1000`, `default: 0`, `labelSv`, `labelEn`; (addendum) `phoneAgentMinutesPerMonth`: `feature: phoneAgent`, `type: int`, `min: 0`, `max: 100000`, `default: 0` |
| `events` | `bus: booqy-events`, the common detail fields, and per source (`booqy.<feature-id>`) each detail-type with its extra fields (section 5) |
| `hooks` | each hook name with `caller`, `targets` (feature ids), `gate` (section 9) |
| `clients` | `meta`, `google_business`, `fortnox`, `visma`, `bedrock`, (addendum) `voice`, `telephony`, `agent_model` with `env` and `tfvar` (section 13) |
| `siteConfig` | `tenantFeatures` list, `tenant.site`, `location.waitlist` (section 7) |
| `slots` | admin, console and site-kit slot ids with `feature`, `ownerOnly`, host (section 8) |
| `storage` | the two new site-kit storage keys (section 10) |
| `enums` | shared enums (1.3) |

Field type mini-language used in `events` and `siteConfig`: `string`,
`int`, `bool`, `date`, `month`, `datetime`, `enum[a,b]`, `list[T]`,
`{field: T}` for an object; a trailing `?` on the field name = optional.

### 1.2 Generated files

Each starts with the header line
`// generated by application/scripts/gen_contracts.py from application/contracts/booqy.yaml, do not edit`
(`#` instead of `//` in Python) and a constant `CONTRACTS_HASH` (first 12 hex
of sha256 of the YAML bytes).

| File | Language | Contains |
|---|---|---|
| `application/shared/contracts.py` | Python | `FEATURE_KEYS` (tuple, 18 after the addendum), `NEW_FEATURE_KEYS` (12 after the addendum), `FeatureKey` (Literal), `FEATURE_IDS` (key -> kebab id), `SITE_CONFIG_FEATURES`, `LIMITS` (dict name -> {feature, min, max, default}), `LimitKey`, `EVENT_BUS = "booqy-events"`, `EVENT_SOURCES`, `EVENTS` (source -> detail-type -> {"required": {...}, "optional": {...}}), one `TypedDict` per detail-type (`MetaConnectionConnectedDetail`, ...), `HOOKS` (name -> {caller, targets, gate}), `CLIENTS`, enum Literals (1.3) |
| `booqy-console/api/src/app/contracts.py` | Python | `FEATURE_KEYS`, `FEATURE_LABELS_EN`, `LIMITS`, `CONSOLE_FORWARD_OPS` (section 9.3) |
| `admin-front-end/src/shared/contracts.ts` | TS | `FEATURE_KEYS as const`, `FeatureKey`, `FEATURE_LABELS: Record<FeatureKey, {sv, en}>`, `LIMIT_KEYS`, `LimitKey`, `LIMITS`, `AdminSlotId` (union) and `ADMIN_SLOTS: Record<AdminSlotId, {feature: FeatureKey \| FeatureKey[]; ownerOnly: boolean}>`, enums |
| `booqy-console/web/src/contracts.ts` | TS | `FEATURE_KEYS`, `FeatureKey`, `FEATURE_LABELS`, `LIMIT_KEYS`, `LIMITS`, `ConsoleSlotId`, `CONSOLE_SLOTS`, enums |
| `customer-front-end/packages/site-kit/src/shared/contracts.ts` | TS | `FEATURE_KEYS`, `FeatureKey`, `SITE_CONFIG_FEATURES`, `SiteFeatureKey`, `SiteBuilderState` (`{mode: 'builder' \| 'custom'; version: number}`), `LocationWaitlist` (`{publicJoin: boolean}`), `SiteSlotId`, `SITE_SLOTS`, `GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_KEY`, `WAITLIST_TOKEN_PREFIX` |

Generator behaviour: `python scripts/gen_contracts.py` writes all five
(paths relative to `application/`, siblings via `../<repo>/`);
`--check` writes nothing and exits 1 listing every file that differs or is
missing. `application/tests/test_contracts.py` regenerates in memory and
asserts: the Python file is identical; every sibling file that exists on
disk is identical (they all exist in the `booqy/` workspace; application CI
checks only its own file, the integrator runs `--check` as a gate); the
YAML is self-consistent (every event source is `booqy.<feature-id>`, every
detail-type matches `^[A-Z][A-Za-z]+\.[A-Z][A-Za-z]*(ed|Set|Left)(In|Out)?$`, every
hook target and slot feature is a known id/key, no duplicate keys).

Detail-type rule as enforced: `<Thing>.<PastTenseVerb>`, PascalCase, the
second part may carry a noun before the verb (`SyncFailed`, `CapReached`,
`DayPosted`) or a particle after it (`CheckedIn`, `CheckedOut`). `Set` and
`Left` are the two irregular past tenses in use.

## 2. Entitlements and limits

Stored on `TENANT#<t>/PROFILE.entitlements = {maxLocations, features{key: bool}, limits{name: int}}`.
`limits` is new (Run 0); a missing limit counts as its default (0). A
missing feature counts as off (unchanged rule).

| Key | Kind | Default | Off behaviour | Exposed in /site-config |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `metaAds` | feature | false | JWT 403 `feature_not_in_plan` | no |
| `siteBuilder` | feature | false | JWT 403; public preview 404 | yes (`tenant.features`, `tenant.site`) |
| `guestCrm` | feature | false | JWT 403 | no |
| `googleBusiness` | feature | false | JWT 403; jobs skip the tenant | no |
| `giftCards` | feature | false | JWT 403; public 404; checkout field 400 `gift_cards_off` | yes |
| `waitlist` | feature | false | JWT 403; public 404 | yes (`tenant.features`, `locations[].waitlist`) |
| `socialPosting` | feature | false | JWT 403; worker fails channel `feature_not_in_plan` | no |
| `personalliggare` | feature | false | JWT 403 except owner export when records exist (ADR-H) | no |
| `accountingSync` | feature | false | JWT 403; callback 404; worker skips | no |
| `dishMargin` | feature | false | routes 403; insights omits margin fields | no |
| `siteBuilderAiEditsPerMonth` | limit (int, 0-1000) | 0 | 0 = every AI edit 429 `quota_exceeded` | no |
| `events` (addendum) | feature | false | JWT 403; public 404; `BokforingCard` group and Statistik slot hidden | yes (`tenant.features.events`) |
| `phoneAgent` (addendum) | feature | false | JWT 403; operator tenant routes 404; inbound call answered with the refusal sentence and ended (`outcome: refused`, reason `entitlement`, 0 minutes); number kept 30 days then released | no |
| `phoneAgentMinutesPerMonth` (addendum) | limit (int, 0-100000) | 0 | included minutes per billing period; the tenant cap defaults to it; minutes above it are the overage line (ADR-L 10) **[NEEDS YOUR OK: values]** | no |

Python helpers (Run 0, `shared/tenant.py`): `FEATURES = contracts.FEATURE_KEYS`;
`limit(tenant_row, name) -> int`; `for_jwt(..., feature=)` and
`for_public(..., feature=)` accept a key or a tuple of keys meaning
**any of** (needed for `metaAds` OR `socialPosting`).

## 4. DynamoDB tables

All: PAY_PER_REQUEST, `PK`/`SK` strings, SSE (AWS-owned key), PITR, TTL
attribute `ttl` where listed, deletion protection in prod (ledger: all
environments). Every item stores `tenantId`. `LOCATION#` partitions are read
only after the tenant/location check. "Purge" = handled by the feature's
`tenant.purge` hook (section 9), not by a list in tenant-purge.

| Table | Feature | PK / SK | GSIs | TTL | Stream | Purge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<prefix>meta-ads` | A | `TENANT#<t>` / `CONNECTION`, `OAUTH#<state>`, `CAMPAIGN#<id>`, `INSIGHT#<campaignId>#<day>`, `SPEND#<month>`, `COPYUSE#<month>` | `byConnected` sparse: `GSI1PK=CONNECTED`, `GSI1SK=<t>` | yes | no | yes, plus secret `booqy/<env>/meta-ads/<t>` |
| `<prefix>site-builder` | B | `TENANT#<t>` / `SITE`, `DRAFT`, `VERSION#<n:06d>`, `PUBLISHED`, `PUBLISH#<id>`, `PREVIEW#<hash>`, `AIUSE#<month>`, `AIPROP#<id>`, `CUSTOM#<sha>` | none | yes | no | yes (S3 `sites/<t>/` already removed via site-repo) |
| `<prefix>guest-crm` | C | `TENANT#<t>` / `IDENT#<channel>#<subject>`, `PROFILE#<guestId>`, `HIST#<guestId>#<at>#<kind>#<sourceId>`, `SEGMENT#<id>`, `EXPORT#<id>`, `EXPORT#<id>#<chunk:04d>`, `BACKFILL` | `byLastSeen` sparse: `GSI1PK=TENANT#<t>#GUESTS`, `GSI1SK=<lastSeenAt>#<guestId>` | yes | no | yes |
| `<prefix>google-business` | D | `TENANT#<t>` / `CONNECTION`, `OAUTH#<state>`, `GLOC#<googleLocationId>`, `REVSENT#<guestKey>`; `LOCATION#<l>` / `LINK`, `REVIEWSETTINGS`, `REVJOB#<kind>#<sourceId>` | `byLinked` sparse: `GSI1PK=LINKED`, `GSI1SK=<t>#<l>` | yes | no | yes, plus secret and pending schedules |
| `<prefix>gift-cards` | E | `TENANT#<t>` / `SETTINGS`, `PURCHASE#<id>`, `CARD#<cardId>` (also `codeSentAt?`, stamped once notification has accepted the code email; `partialRefundOre?` / `partialRefundAt?`, set by a partial `charge.refunded`), `CODE#<codeHmac>`, `CARD#<cardId>#TX#<txId>` (a `refund` TX also gets `stripeRefundId?` once Stripe has the refund), `TXREF#<txId>` (`cardId`, `verifiedAt?`: Kassa finds a redemption by its `paymentId`; written in the same transaction as the TX row); `JOB` / `NIGHTLY` (one row per table, no tenant: `lastDay` = resume point of the nightly job) | `byLocationDay`: `GSI1PK=TENANT#<t>#LOC#<l>#<day>`, `GSI1SK=<at>#<txId>` (TX only); `byExpiry` sparse, three day-buckets read only by the nightly job: `GSI2PK=EXPIRY#<day>` (active CARD, `GSI2SK=<t>#<cardId>`), `GSI2PK=CLEANUP#<day>` (used/expired/void CARD, day = last TX + 24 months, contact fields removed then), `GSI2PK=UNVERIFIED#<day>` (TXREF of a Kassa redeem Kassa has not verified, `GSI2SK=<t>#<txId>`; reversed after 30 min, removed on verify, reverse or purge) | yes (holds; on purge, CARD/CODE/TX/TXREF get `ttl` = end of 7th year after the last TX) | no | partial: SETTINGS, PURCHASE, contact fields now; bookkeeping rows by TTL |
| `<prefix>waitlist` | F | `LOCATION#<l>` / `ENTRY#<day>#<entryId>`, `SETTINGS` | none | yes (end of day + 30 d) | **no** (SMS via notification invoke, section 9.4) | yes |
| `<prefix>social-posting` | G | `TENANT#<t>` / `POST#<postId>` (each channel state also carries `firstAttemptAt`, set with its first publish lease; FB `needs_check` recovery adopts only a Page post created at or after it) | none | yes | no | yes |
| `<prefix>personalliggare` | H | `TENANT#<t>` / `PERSON#<id>`, `USER#<sub>`; `LOCATION#<l>` / `HEAD`, `PRESENT#<personId>`, `REQ#<recordId>` | none | yes (REQ 7 d) | no | yes, after a final export is offered |
| `<prefix>personalliggare-ledger` | H | `LOCATION#<l>` / `SEQ#<12-digit seq>` | `byDay`: `GSI1PK=DAY#<l>#<day>`, `GSI1SK=SEQ#<12-digit seq>` | yes (end of 2nd calendar year, legal to confirm) | no | **never** (Deny resource policy, deletion protection everywhere) |
| `<prefix>accounting-sync` | I | `TENANT#<t>` / `CONNECTION`, `OAUTH#<nonce>`, `COMPANY#<companyKey>#DAY#<day>`; `LOCATION#<l>` / `DAY#<day>` | none | yes (DAY 7 years, OAUTH 10 min) | no | yes, plus secret |
| `<prefix>dish-margin` | J | `LOCATION#<l>` / `COST#<menuItemId>#<validFrom>`, `SETTINGS` | none | no | no | yes |
| `<prefix>events-tickets` (addendum) | K | `TENANT#<t>` / `EVENT#<eventId>`, `EVENT#<eventId>#OCC#<startAt>`, `EVENT#<eventId>#TYPE#<typeId>`, `ORDER#<orderId>`, `TICKET#<ticketId>`, `CODE#<codeHmac>`, `TRANSFER#<transferId>`, `TX#<txId>`, `JOB#<jobId>` | `byOccurrence`: `GSI1PK=TENANT#<t>#OCC#<occurrenceId>`, `GSI1SK=<holderName>#<ticketId>` (TICKET only); `byLocationDay`: `GSI2PK=TENANT#<t>#LOC#<l>#<day>`, `GSI2SK=<at>#<txId>` (TX only) | yes (pending ORDER 15 min, TRANSFER, JOB 7 d) | no | partial: everything now except TX rows, which get `ttl` = end of the 7th year |
| `<prefix>phone-agent` (addendum) | L | `TENANT#<t>` / `CONFIG`, `LOC#<l>#CONFIG`, `NUMBER#<e164>`, `CALL#<day>#<callId>`, `CALL#<day>#<callId>#T#<seq:05d>`, `CALLBACK#<callbackId>`, `USAGE#<periodEnd>`, `SIM#<sessionId>` | `byNumber` sparse: `GSI1PK=NUMBER#<e164>`, `GSI1SK=<t>#<l>`; `byReservation` sparse: `GSI2PK=TENANT#<t>#RES#<reservationId>`, `GSI2SK=<startedAt>` | yes (turns 24 months, CALL 7 years, CALLBACK 90 d after close, SIM 1 h) **[NEEDS YOUR OK: retention]** | no | yes, plus numbers released, provider agents deleted, recordings deleted, `USER#agent:<l>` rows removed |

## 5. Events

One custom bus `<prefix>booqy-events` (Run 0, `infrastructure/events/`).
Source `booqy.<feature-id>`. Every detail has the **common fields**
`tenantId: string`, `occurredAt: datetime`, `version: 1`. No names, emails,
phones, identity numbers, codes or amounts that are business secrets
(dish costs) in any detail. Publish with `shared/events.py`
`publish(feature_id, detail_type, detail)` (validates against `EVENTS`,
fills `occurredAt` and `version`, `PutEvents` to env `EVENT_BUS_NAME`).
Producer roles: `events:PutEvents` on the bus ARN with condition
`events:source = booqy.<feature-id>`. Consumers create their own rule and
an SQS DLQ in their own module.

| Source | Detail-type | Extra detail fields | Producer | Consumers |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `booqy.meta-ads` | `MetaConnection.Connected` | `adAccountId: string`, `pageId: string`, `instagramId?: string` | meta-ads | none |
| `booqy.meta-ads` | `MetaConnection.Disconnected` | `reason: enum[owner,token_revoked,offboarding]` | meta-ads, meta-ads-jobs | social-posting (moves scheduled posts to draft) |
| `booqy.meta-ads` | `MetaCampaign.Created` | `campaignId`, `locationId`, `goal: enum[bookings,orders,catering,awareness]`, `budgetSek: int`, `endDate: date` | meta-ads-jobs | none |
| `booqy.meta-ads` | `MetaCampaign.Activated` | `campaignId`, `locationId` | meta-ads | none |
| `booqy.meta-ads` | `MetaCampaign.Paused` | `campaignId`, `by: enum[owner,cap,kill_switch]` | meta-ads, meta-ads-jobs | none |
| `booqy.meta-ads` | `MetaSpend.CapReached` | `month: month`, `spendSek: int`, `capSek: int` | meta-ads-jobs | none |
| `booqy.site-builder` | `SiteVersion.Published` | `versionNo: int`, `previousNo?: int`, `source: enum[builder,custom]`, `kind: enum[publish,rollback]` | site-builder | none |

No detail ever carries a phone number, a transcript, a holder name or an
email (addendum rule restated).

Delivery: at least once; every consumer is idempotent (deterministic schedule
names, conditional writes). Producers publish after the write succeeds;
a publish failure is logged with a metric and never fails the request.

## 6. Routes

Common to every route (not repeated below): errors are
`{error, code, field?}`; 400 `unsupported fields` for unknown body fields;
JWT routes 401 `unauthorized`, 403 `no_tenant`, `tenant_inactive`,
`feature_not_in_plan`, `owner_only`; foreign or unknown ids 404 `not found`
(same body as unknown); optimistic writes 409 `changed_retry`; AWS errors
503. Public routes return 404 when the tenant is inactive, the feature is
off or anything about the token or code is wrong. Contact data and codes
travel only in bodies, never in query strings or paths.

Auth column: **jwt** = API Gateway authorizer `cognito` (tenant pool;
tenant from the `tenant_id` claim); **operator** = authorizer `platform`
with scope `platform/admin`, handled by `platform-tenants` (Booqy Console
API), which forwards to the feature (section 9.3) and writes an `AUDIT#`
row for every write; **public** = no authorizer (Turnstile and request guard
where noted, else a token). Roles: `owner` = `owner_user`, `staff` =
`staff_user` (held to their assigned location; another location is 404).

### 6.A Meta ads (`metaAds`)

| # | Method + path | Auth | Roles | Entitlement | Request -> response | Feature errors | Idempotency |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | GET `/tenant/meta-ads/connection` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` or `socialPosting` | -> `{status, assets?, dsa, monthlyCapSek, spendThisMonthSek, killSwitch, missingPermissions[]}` | none | n/a |
| A2 | POST `/tenant/meta-ads/connection/start` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` or `socialPosting` | `{}` -> `{authorizeUrl}`; scopes = A's list, plus G's when `socialPosting` on | none | new state per call |
| A3 | POST `/tenant/meta-ads/connection/callback` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` or `socialPosting` | `{code, state}` -> connection | 400 `invalid_state` | state single use |
| A4 | GET `/tenant/meta-ads/assets` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` or `socialPosting` | -> `{businesses[], adAccounts[], pages[], instagram[], missing[{kind, deepLink}]}` | 409 `not_connected` | n/a |
| A5 | PUT `/tenant/meta-ads/connection` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` or `socialPosting` | `{adAccountId?, pageId, instagramId?, dsa{beneficiary, payor}?, monthlyCapSek?, version}` -> connection (`adAccountId`, `dsa`, cap required when `metaAds` on) | 400 `invalid_cap`, `unknown_asset` | `version` |
| A6 | DELETE `/tenant/meta-ads/connection` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` or `socialPosting` | -> 204; pauses campaigns, deletes secret | none | second call 204 |
| A7 | POST `/locations/{locationId}/meta-ads/copy` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` | `{menuItemId, goal}` -> `{suggestions[{headline, primaryText}]}` | 429 `quota_exceeded`, 502 `ai_unavailable` | counted once per call |
| A8 | POST `/locations/{locationId}/meta-ads/campaigns` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` | `{campaignId, goal, menuItemId, headline, primaryText, budgetSek, days, radiusKm}` -> 202 campaign (`publishing`) | 400 `invalid_budget`, `invalid_radius`, `invalid_days`, `alcohol_not_allowed`, `text_too_long`; 409 `not_connected`, `assets_missing` (ad account, Page, dish image **or the location's stored `position`** missing; `field: "position"` when it is the position), `cap_exceeded`, `kill_switch` | client ULID `campaignId` = execution name; a row still `publishing` without an `executionArn` is started by the retry, and by the 15-minute sweep of `meta-ads-jobs` once it is 10 min old (if that start fails too the sweep marks it `failed`, `error.code = start_failed`) |
| A9 | GET `/locations/{locationId}/meta-ads/campaigns` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` | -> `{campaigns[]}` (newest first, one page: the response **never** carries a `cursor`) | 400 `cursor` (any `cursor` query parameter) | n/a |
| A10 | GET `/locations/{locationId}/meta-ads/campaigns/{campaignId}` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` | -> campaign + `previewUrl?`; a `failed` campaign carries `error{code}` (no `field`): a publish-workflow code (`meta_unavailable` unless the cause names `kill_switch`, `not_connected`, `assets_missing`, `unknown_image`, `invalid_status`, `feature_not_in_plan` or `not_found`) or `start_failed` (the sweep could not start a publish stranded for 10 min; admin: "Annonsen kom aldrig i gång. Skapa den igen.") | none | n/a |
| A11 | POST `.../campaigns/{campaignId}/activate` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` | `{version}` -> campaign (`active`) | 409 `cap_exceeded`, `kill_switch`, `invalid_status` | `version` + status; retry returns active |
| A12 | POST `.../campaigns/{campaignId}/pause` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` | `{version}` -> campaign (`paused`) | 409 `invalid_status` | retry returns paused |
| A13 | GET `/locations/{locationId}/meta-ads/insights?from=&to=` | jwt | owner | `metaAds` | -> `{rows[{campaignId, day, spendSek, reach, clicks, bookings, orders, costPerBookingSek, costPerOrderSek}], totals}` | 400 `invalid_range` | n/a |
| A14 | GET `/platform/meta-ads/settings` | operator | platform_admin | n/a | -> `{killSwitch, maxMonthlyCapSek}` | none | n/a |
| A15 | PUT `/platform/meta-ads/settings` | operator | platform_admin | n/a | `{killSwitch, maxMonthlyCapSek}` -> settings | 400 `invalid_cap` | same body same result |
| A16 | PUT `/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/meta-ads` | operator | platform_admin | n/a | `{paused}` -> `{paused}` | 404 unknown tenant | same body same result |
| A17 | GET `/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/meta-ads` | operator | platform_admin | n/a | -> `{status, adAccountId?, pageId?, instagramId?, paused, spendThisMonthSek}` (console Integrations tab; added by contract) | 404 unknown tenant | n/a |

502 `meta_unavailable` on any route that calls Meta.

### 6.B Site builder (`siteBuilder`)

| # | Method + path | Auth | Roles | Entitlement | Request -> response | Feature errors | Idempotency |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | GET `/tenant/site-builder` | jwt | owner | `siteBuilder` | -> `{mode, draft{doc, version, basedOn}, published{versionNo, publishedAt}?, aiQuota?{used, limit}}` | none | n/a |
| B2 | PUT `/tenant/site-builder/draft` | jwt | owner | `siteBuilder` | `{doc, version}` -> draft | 400 `schema_invalid`, `doc_too_large`, `invalid_link`, `unknown_image` (`field` = JSON pointer); 409 `wrong_mode` | `version` |
| B3 | POST `/tenant/site-builder/preview-links` | jwt | owner | `siteBuilder` | `{}` -> `{url, expiresAt}` | none | new token per call |
| B4 | POST `/tenant/site-builder/publish` | jwt | owner | `siteBuilder` | `{publishId, draftVersion}` or `{publishId, source: "custom", commitSha}` -> 202 `{publishId, status}` | 400 `contrast_too_low` (safety net: theme pairs are nudged to >= 4.5:1 first, ADR-B 3) and B2 errors; 409 `publish_running`, `wrong_mode` | client ULID `publishId` = execution name; a row whose workflow never started (B5 `start_failed`) is restarted by the retry |
| B5 | GET `/tenant/site-builder/publish/{publishId}` | jwt | owner | `siteBuilder` | -> `{status, versionNo?, error?{code, field?}}`; `code` is a B2/B4 validation code (with `field`) or `start_failed` (StartExecution failed, no `field`; B4 or B7 with the same `publishId` starts it again) | none | n/a |
| B6 | GET `/tenant/site-builder/versions` | jwt | owner | `siteBuilder` | -> `{versions[{versionNo, source, publishedAt, publishedBy, live}]}` | none | n/a |
| B7 | POST `/tenant/site-builder/rollback` | jwt | owner | `siteBuilder` | `{publishId, versionNo}` -> 202 `{publishId}` | 409 `publish_running` | `publishId` (a `start_failed` row is restarted by the retry); live version = 200 no-op |
| B8 | POST `/public/site-builder/preview` | public (token + request guard) | guest | `siteBuilder` | `{tenantId, token}` -> `{doc}` | 404 on any bad token | n/a |
| B9 | POST `/tenant/site-builder/ai-edits` (B2) | jwt | owner | `siteBuilder` + limit | `{proposalId, prompt, draftVersion}` -> `{patch, before, after, quota{used, limit}}` | 400 `prompt_too_long`, `invalid_patch`; 429 `quota_exceeded`; 502 `ai_unavailable` | `proposalId` counted once |
| B10 | POST `/tenant/site-builder/ai-edits/{proposalId}/apply` (B2) | jwt | owner | `siteBuilder` | `{draftVersion}` -> draft | 409 `changed_retry` | second apply 200 same draft |
| B11 | GET `/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/site-builder` (B2) | operator | platform_admin | n/a | -> `{mode, published, releases[{commitSha, prNumber, previewUrl, status}]}` | 404 | n/a |
| B12 | PUT `/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/site-builder/mode` (B2) | operator | platform_admin | n/a | `{mode, version}` -> `{mode}` | 400 bad mode | `version` |
| B13 | POST `/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/site-builder/custom/{commitSha}/ready` (B2) | operator | platform_admin | n/a | `{}` -> CUSTOM item | 404 unknown sha | repeat same result |

**Reserved page slugs.** A page `slug` that the customer app routes itself
as a first path segment (`meny`, `boka-bord`, `bestall`, `catering`,
`presentkort`, `ko`, `forhandsvisning`, `evenemang`, `biljett`, ...) or that
is an S3 prefix under `sites/<t>/` (`v`, `releases`, `preview`, `assets`)
would never be shown, so B2 and B4 refuse it with 400 `schema_invalid`,
`field` = `/pages/<i>/slug` (the same code and pointer as a duplicate slug).
The one list is `RESERVED_SLUGS` in
`application/shared/features/site_builder/__init__.py`; a test asserts it
covers every `path="..."` in `customer-front-end/src/App.tsx`, so a new
customer-app route is added there first. Site-kit's `sitePages` keys (8.4)
are among them.

### 6.E Gift cards (`giftCards`)

| # | Method + path | Auth | Roles | Entitlement | Request -> response | Feature errors | Idempotency |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E1 | GET `/public/locations/{locationId}/gift-cards/offer` | public | guest | `giftCards` | -> `{amountsSek[], customMinSek, customMaxSek, validityMonths}` | none | n/a |
| E2 | POST `/public/locations/{locationId}/gift-cards/checkout` | public (Turnstile + request guard, throttle `public`) | guest | `giftCards` | `{purchaseId, amountSek, buyerEmail, recipientName?, recipientEmail?, message?, turnstileToken}` -> `{clientSecret, stripeAccount, amountSek, expiresAt}` (`stripeAccount` is the connected account id the PaymentIntent lives on; Stripe Elements needs it to confirm the payment) | 400 `invalid_amount`, `invalid_email`, `message_too_long`, `turnstile_failed`; 429; 502 `stripe_unavailable` | `purchaseId` = Stripe key `giftcard-<purchaseId>` |
| E3 | POST `/public/locations/{locationId}/gift-cards/balance` | public (Turnstile + request guard, throttle `public`) | guest | `giftCards` | `{code, turnstileToken}` -> `{balanceSek, expiresAt, status}` | any miss 404 | n/a |
| E4 | GET `/tenant/gift-cards/settings` | jwt | owner | `giftCards` | -> settings | none | n/a |
| E5 | PUT `/tenant/gift-cards/settings` | jwt | owner | `giftCards` | `{enabled, amountsSek, customMinSek, customMaxSek, validityMonths, version}` -> settings | 400 `invalid_validity`, `invalid_amount` | `version` |
| E6 | GET `/tenant/gift-cards?status=&cursor=` | jwt | owner | `giftCards` | -> `{cards[{cardId, last4, initialSek, balanceSek, status, expiresAt}], liabilitySek, cursor}` | 400 bad status | n/a |
| E7 | GET `/tenant/gift-cards/{cardId}` | jwt | owner | `giftCards` | -> card + `transactions[]` | none | n/a |
| E8 | POST `/tenant/gift-cards/{cardId}/adjust` | jwt | owner | `giftCards` | `{txId, expiresAt?, reason}` -> card | 400 shorter expiry | `txId` |
| E9 | POST `/tenant/gift-cards/{cardId}/refund` | jwt | owner | `giftCards` | `{txId, reason}` -> card (`void`). The card first: one `refund` TX of the balance the request read, conditional on the card `version`; then a Stripe refund of exactly that amount (key `giftcard-refund-<txId>`), after which `stripeRefundId` on the TX marks the Stripe side done | 409 `refund_window_passed`, `card_void`, `changed_retry` (a redemption moved the balance in between: nothing refunded, read the card and call again); 502 `stripe_unavailable` (the card is already void; call again with the same `txId`) | `txId`: a retry returns the card and finishes the Stripe refund only while the TX has no `stripeRefundId`; one TX, one Stripe refund |
| E10 | POST `/tenant/gift-cards/{cardId}/resend` | jwt | owner | `giftCards` | `{to: buyer \| recipient}` -> 202 `{last4}`; codes are never stored, so "Skicka ny kod" **rotates** the code: new CODE# row, old one deleted, `codeHmac`/`last4` replaced on the card in one transaction, then the new code is mailed (`gift-cards.code-resend`); the old code stops working at once, which the admin confirms with the owner first | 400 bad target, no email for that target; 409 `card_expired`, `card_void`, `changed_retry`; 502 `notification_unavailable` (notification did not take the email: the code is already rotated and unsent, so the old code no longer works; calling again is safe and rotates once more, then mails the new code) | not idempotent by design (every call is a new code; only the latest works) |
| E11 | POST `/locations/{locationId}/gift-cards/lookup` | jwt | owner, staff | `giftCards` | `{code}` -> `{cardId, last4, balanceSek, expiresAt, status}` | 400 missing code | n/a |
| E12 | POST `/locations/{locationId}/gift-cards/redemptions` | jwt | owner, staff | `giftCards` and `kassa` | `{txId (= Kassa paymentId), code, amountOre, billId}` -> `{balanceAfterSek, txId}` | 409 `insufficient_balance`, `card_expired`, `card_void` | `txId`; same id other amount 409 |
| E13 | POST `/locations/{locationId}/gift-cards/redemptions/{txId}/reverse` | jwt | owner, staff | `giftCards` and `kassa` | `{}` -> `{balanceAfterSek}` | 409 `receipt_issued` | second reverse same balance |

Existing route change (Run 0, hotspot): the order checkout body
(`payment-intent`) gains optional `giftCardCode: string`; with `giftCards`
off it is 400 `gift_cards_off`; otherwise it goes through the
`checkout.giftcard` hook (section 9).

Not an API Gateway route: the agent turn endpoint `POST /v1/chat/completions`
(OpenAI-compatible SSE) on the `phone-agent-call` Function URL, protected by
`${prefix}phone-agent/llm-endpoint-key` in a header and bound to a known,
live `callId`. Tool execution invokes the existing functions listed in
ADR-L "Bedrock agent" directly (no new routes on them).

**Agent tools that changed on 2026-11-04 (ADR-L decision 13, counter-offers;
the tool list itself is unchanged).** `get_availability(date, partySize,
time?, timeFrom?, timeTo?)` -> `{times[], requestedTime?, before[],
after[], nearby[{tableIds[], seats, kind: adjacent_pair | larger |
phone_only}], dayFull}`; `hold_table(date, time, partySize, tableIds?)`
-> `{holdId, date, time, partySize, tableIds}` or `{held: false, reason:
time_taken | day_full, time, before[], after[], nearby[], dayFull?}`
(a bookability check with a proposal id, no server-side hold);
`create_reservation` books through the staff route
`POST /locations/{l}/reservations/manual` with `source: "phone"` and the
proposal's `tableIds`. Both availability tools read `get-availability:live`
(guest and staff views) and `list-layout-version:live` (`GET
/locations/{l}/layout/active`, the floor plan for `adjacent_pair`), so the
`phone-agent-call` role invokes eight existing functions (section 14).
The order the agent offers in is fixed by the ADR: requested time, nearby
table at that time, the three closest same-day times on both sides, the
next day once, then a callback. The simulator (`shared/agent_model.py`
`COUNTER_OFFERS`, `NEARBY_TABLE`, `nearest_times`) and
`tests/test_phone_agent_counter_offers.py` are the executable form of
that order in Swedish and English.

## 7. `/site-config` additions

Backend `functions/tenant-site-config/app.py` and site-kit
`packages/site-kit/src/shared/site.ts` `SiteConfig` (both Run 0 only).

| Field | Type | Present when | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tenant.features.giftCards` | bool | always | entitlements |
| `tenant.features.waitlist` | bool | always | entitlements |
| `tenant.features.siteBuilder` | bool | always | entitlements |
| `tenant.site` | `{mode: 'builder' \| 'custom', version: int}` (version = live `versionNo`, 0 = nothing published) | `siteBuilder` on and PROFILE has `site` | `TENANT#<t>/PROFILE.site`, written by site-builder |
| `locations[].waitlist` | `{publicJoin: bool}` | `waitlist` on and the location row has `waitlist` | location row `waitlist`, written by waitlist F6 |
| `tenant.features.events` (addendum) | bool | always | entitlements (`siteConfig: true` in the YAML; `SITE_CONFIG_FEATURES` grows to nine) |

`tenant.features` keeps its existing five keys and does **not** gain `kassa`
or the other new keys (staff-only features, nothing guest-facing). That is
the deliberate answer to the "`_FEATURES` lacks kassa" mismatch.
`phoneAgent` adds nothing to `/site-config` (the guest site shows the
restaurant's own number as today; the Booqy number is only a forwarding
target).

## 9. Feature hooks (extension points inside shared code)

Shared Lambdas that need feature data call the feature's API Lambda
(`<prefix><feature-id>:live`) synchronously instead of reading feature
tables. One IAM grant per caller (`lambda:InvokeFunction`), no feature
table names or IAM on the caller, and each feature keeps its own data
rules. Helper: `shared/feature_hooks.py` (Run 0).

### 9.1 Envelope

- Request: `{"hook": "<name>", "hookVersion": 1, "tenantId": "<t>", ...fields}`.
- Response: `{"ok": true, ...}` or `{"ok": false, "status": 400|404|409, "code": "<code>", "field"?: "<f>"}`.
- The feature handler dispatches on `"hook" in event and "requestContext" not in event`; an API Gateway event can never be read as a hook.
- `call(hook, payload, targets=None) -> dict[feature_id, response]`: `ResourceNotFoundException` (feature not deployed yet, so it has no data) -> skipped and logged once; a `FunctionError`, timeout or non-JSON -> `HookFailed(feature_id)`, the caller answers 503 (API) or retries next run (jobs). Read timeout 10 s, 60 s for `tenant.purge`.
- Tests use `tests/hooks_fake.py` `install_hook(monkeypatch, feature_id, hook, fn)`; no real Lambda in unit tests.

### 9.2 Hook table

**Gating rule ("on or ever on", decided in the Run 0 review).** A hook for
feature X is invoked for a tenant only when X is on now **or has ever been
on** for that tenant. The console stamps every feature key that is turned on
into the tenant row's `entitlements.featuresEver` (a string set, only ever
grows; written by `create_tenant` and `set_plan` in the same update as
`entitlements`). `shared/tenant.ever_on(tenant_row, key)` is true when the key
is on or in `featuresEver`. "always" below means "on or ever on". So existing
tenants (no feature ever on) never invoke a Lambda, and turning a feature off
still lets erase, export, SIE history and gift card events reach its data.
`tenant.purge` is the exception: it calls every target (offboarding).


| Hook | Caller (hotspot, built in Run 0) | Targets | Called when | Request fields | Response fields |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `privacy.export` | guest-privacy `GET /privacy/guests` | guest-crm, google-business, gift-cards, waitlist | on or ever on | `email?`, `phone?`, `subjects{email?, sms?}` | `items: list` (added to the export as `features.<feature-id>`) |
| `privacy.erase` | guest-privacy `POST /privacy/guests/erase` | same four | on or ever on | same | `erased{kind: count}`, `kept{kind: count}` (counts only) |
| `tenant.purge` | tenant-purge, per purged tenant per round | all ten | always | `locationIds[]`, `round` | `done: bool`, `counts{}`; not done -> called again next round |
| `stripe.event` | stripe-webhook, when `metadata.kind = giftcard` | gift-cards | on or ever on | `type`, `account`, `object` | `result: string`: `issued`, `already_issued`, `code_resent` (a `payment_intent.succeeded` replay for an issued, active card without `codeSentAt` and older than 2 minutes: the code is rotated and `gift-cards.code` sent again), `voided`, `already_void`, `flagged:partial_refund` (`charge.refunded` with `amount_refunded != amount`: `partialRefundOre` / `partialRefundAt` on the card, no balance change), `ignored:*`. **gift-cards must ignore the event (`result: ignored:account_mismatch`) unless `account` equals the `stripeAccountId` stored on the card's own purchase or TX row**: the caller only checks the signature and live mode, and `metadata.tenantId` comes from whoever created the PaymentIntent on their connected account |
| `checkout.giftcard` | payment-intent (`op: reserve`); webhook-payment-intent on `checkout.session.expired` / payment failed (`op: reverse`); manage-order staff cancel (`op: refund`, after the Stripe refund) | gift-cards | `giftCards` on and `giftCardCode` present (reserve); order carries `giftCard` (reverse, refund: regardless of the flag) | `op` (`reserve`, `reverse`, `refund`), `locationId`, `orderId`, `code?`, `totalOre?` | reserve: `debitedOre`, `cardId`, `cardLast4`; reverse and refund: `reversedOre` |
| `kassa.giftcard` | kassa bill payment `kind: giftcard` (`op: verify`), undo before receipt (`op: reverse`) | gift-cards | `giftCards` and `kassa` on, and the control system port has a voucher payment means (`ControlSystem.voucher_method`; while it is `None` the payment is refused 501 before any hook call, so no card is debited on a bill whose receipt cannot be made) | `op`, `locationId`, `billId`, `paymentId` | `amountOre`, `cardId`, `cardLast4`, `balanceAfterOre` |
| `accounting.events` | `shared/accounting.location_events` (accounting export and accounting-sync) | gift-cards | on or ever on | `locationId`, `first`, `last` | `events[{day, postings[{role, amount, text}], warnings[]}]` (shape of `shared.accounting.Event`) |
| `insights.dishCosts` | insights `GET /insights?locationId=` | dish-margin | `dishMargin` on and caller is owner | `locationIds[]`, `first`, `last` | `targetMarginPct`, `costs{menuItemId: [{validFrom, costOre}]}` |
| `marketing.segment` | marketing (campaign save, `op: describe`), marketing-send (`op: page`) | guest-crm | audience `{type: "segment", exportId}` | `op`, `exportId`, `cursor?` | describe: `count`; page: `subscriberIds[]`, `cursor?` |
| `platform` | platform-tenants feature modules (operator routes) | meta-ads, site-builder, google-business, personalliggare, (addendum) phone-agent | operator route hit | `op`, `body`, `query`, `operator{sub, email}` | `status`, `body` |
| `insights.events` (addendum, caller built in the Run 2 hotspot batch) | insights `GET /insights?locationId=` | events-tickets | `events` on or ever on | `locationIds[]`, `first`, `last` | `days[{day, occurrences, ticketsSold, revenueOre, checkedIn}]` |
| `billing.usage` (addendum, caller built in the Run 2 hotspot batch) | platform-tenants invoicing task (`financeTask: invoice`) and the console Billing tab | phone-agent | `phoneAgent` on or ever on | `periodStart`, `periodEnd` | `lines[{locationId, minutes}]`, `includedMinutes` |

### 9.4 Notification send (direct invoke of `notification:live`)

Features never send email or SMS themselves (D's review request **email**
uses the existing marketing mail path, `shared/marketing_mail.py` with
List-Unsubscribe, ADR-D; its **SMS** goes through `notification:live` like
every other feature SMS). Callers invoke `notification:live` with
`InvocationType=Event`:

`{"notice": {"version": 1, "kind": "<feature-id>.<message>", "tenantId", "locationId"?, "channel": "email" | "sms", "to", "subject"?, "text", "html"?, "replyTo": "location" | "tenant" | null}}`

Notification (Run 0) applies the tenant sender name and From, Reply-To,
SMS prefixes and part counting (billing kind = `kind`), the dev outbox, and
logs counts only. Event-invoke retries on notification are set to 0, so a
message is never sent twice by Lambda; the caller records "sent" on its own
item before invoking and owns the Swedish copy (rendered with
`shared/messages.py` helpers, read-only). Two callers refine that rule
(built 2026-11-04, DECISIONS.md): gift-cards stamps `codeSentAt` on the
card right after the invoke is accepted (status 202; anything else
raises), and a `payment_intent.succeeded` replay for a card still
without it after a 2-minute grace rotates the code and sends
`gift-cards.code` again (`stripe.event` result `code_resent`);
google-business-jobs claims the job before the invoke and, when the
invoke (or the email send) fails, releases the claim and the cooldown row
and raises, so the schedule's retry sends it. Kinds: `gift-cards.code`,
`gift-cards.code-resend`, `waitlist.joined`, `waitlist.offered`,
`waitlist.expired`, `meta-ads.cap-warning` (email to every active owner
when month-to-date spend reaches 80 % of the monthly cap, sent by
`meta-ads-jobs` from the nightly insights run, once per month via
`SPEND#<month>.warnedAt`; ADR-A 6), `google-business.review-request` (SMS,
sent by `google-business-jobs` at the review schedule's fire time to a
guest with SMS consent, `replyTo: null`; the email variant of the same
request is sent by marketing mail under the same kind string for
billing, not through notification; ADR-D 7). The gift card code is in the
invoke payload only, never in a table or log; `gift-cards.code-resend`
carries a **new** code (E10 rotates it, the old code stops working).
Addendum kinds: `events-tickets.tickets` (email, the
tickets with QR and Wallet links), `events-tickets.transfer` (email, gift
or resale link), `events-tickets.refunded` (email), `events-tickets.cancelled`
(email, occurrence cancelled); `phone-agent.guarantee-link` (SMS, the
existing payment link), `phone-agent.callback-summary` (email to the
location, optional), `phone-agent.cap-warning` (email to the owner at
80 %). Ticket tokens and QR payloads travel in the payload only.

| admin `src/shared/storageRegistry.ts` (addendum) | `EVENT_SCAN_KEY_PREFIX` | `booqy-event-scan-<occurrenceId>` | IndexedDB | Booqy (Evenemang, insläpp) | Sparar gästlistan och insläpp som gjorts utan nät vid dörren, tills de har skickats till servern. | Tills insläppen är synkade, senast dagen efter evenemanget | nödvändig | K |

No new keys in the console registry; L adds none anywhere (the simulator
session lives on the server as `SIM#`). B's preview token and K's ticket
tokens stay in the URL fragment and are never stored. Run 0 added the first
two entries; the addendum adds the next two (admin's registry is no longer
"no new keys": the `storageRegistry.test.ts` rules apply, IndexedDB counts
as a `kind`). The features import the constants.

Price variables default to 0 so no invoice line is produced until the
owner sets them (the invoicing run skips 0-priced lines, like SMS).

Simulator refusal in prod is at runtime (the factory raises when
`ENVIRONMENT=prod`), not in Terraform, so prod keeps planning while the
features are off. Feature agents add no root variables; anything a feature
needs is a constant in its module or a `module` input from its own root file.

`wiring` output, fixed shape (empty in Run 0); `config.tf` merges all ten:

```hcl
output "wiring" {
  value = {
    lambda_releases         = {} # "<fn name>" => { alias_name = "live" }
    tenant_aware_role_names = {} # "<fn_name_underscored>" => role name
    staff_check_role_names  = {} # same keys, functions where staff act
    api_integrations        = {} # "<feature-id>" => { function_name, invoke_arn }
  }
}
```

### 12.3 Route entries (`<feature-id>-routes.tf`)

```hcl
locals {
  meta_ads_routes = [
    { route_key = "GET /tenant/meta-ads/connection", auth = "jwt" },
    { route_key = "PUT /platform/meta-ads/settings", auth = "operator" },
    # public routes add: throttle = "public"
  ]
}
```

`auth`: `jwt` -> `cognito` authorizer, feature integration; `public` -> no
authorizer, feature integration; `operator` -> `platform` authorizer with
no scope (like the existing platform-tenants routes, whose console tokens
do not carry `platform/admin`; the handler checks the `platform_admin`
group), existing platform-tenants integration, in a separate route
resource (`feature_operator`) to avoid a dependency cycle.
`throttle = "public"` applies the same `route_settings` as the existing
public guest routes. A plan fails (precondition) if a feature lists jwt or
public routes without an `api_integrations` entry. `ROUTES.md` is
regenerated by the integrator only (`generate_routes.py` reads these files).

## 13. External client ports

Pattern of `shared/control_system.py`: port class, `Simulated*`, real class,
factory `client()` reading `<X>_CLIENT`; `simulator` raises
`RuntimeError("<x> simulator is not allowed in prod")` when
`ENVIRONMENT=prod`; an unknown value raises. Run 0 builds port, simulator,
factory and tests for all five; real classes are skeletons raising
`NotImplementedError` in separate files (`shared/<x>_real.py`), owned by the
feature in the table. Simulators are deterministic, keep state in the
instance, and accept `fail={"method": n}` to raise the port's error on the
first n calls (for idempotency and resume tests). Errors: one
`<X>Error(code, retryable)` per port.

| Port (file) | Methods | Simulator behaviour | Real owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MetaGraph` (`shared/meta_graph.py`) | `authorize_url(state, redirect_uri, scopes)`, `exchange_code(code, redirect_uri) -> Token{access_token, scopes}`, `list_assets(token) -> Assets{businesses, ad_accounts[{id, name, currency, has_payment_method}], pages, instagram}`, `upload_image(token, ad_account_id, data, name) -> hash`, `create_campaign(token, ad_account_id, name, objective) -> id` (always PAUSED), `create_ad_set(token, ad_account_id, campaign_id, name, lifetime_budget_ore, start, end, geo{lat, lng, radius_km}, age_min, dsa_beneficiary, dsa_payor) -> id`, `create_creative(token, ad_account_id, name, page_id, instagram_id, image_hash, headline, primary_text, link, cta) -> id`, `create_ad(token, ad_account_id, name, ad_set_id, creative_id) -> id`, `find_by_name(token, ad_account_id, kind, name) -> id \| None`, `set_status(token, object_id, status)`, `insights(token, ad_account_id, campaign_ids, day) -> rows`, `preview_url(token, ad_id)`, `revoke(token)`; G: `publish_page_photo(token, page_id, image_url, caption) -> post_id`, `create_ig_container(token, ig_user_id, image_url, caption) -> container_id`, `publish_ig_container(token, ig_user_id, container_id) -> media_id` (second publish of one container raises `already_published`), `recent_page_posts(token, page_id, limit) -> [{id, message, permalink}]` | `authorize_url` points straight back at the admin callback with `code=simulated`; ids `sim-<kind>-<sha1(name)[:10]>`, idempotent by name; one business, SEK ad account with payment method, one Page, one Instagram (`missing=("ad_account",)` etc. to drop assets); insights deterministic from `(campaign_id, day)`; records every call in `calls` | A (G may not edit) |
| `GoogleBusiness` (`shared/google_business.py`) | `authorize_url(state, redirect_uri)`, `exchange_code(code, redirect_uri) -> Token{refresh_token, access_token, account_name}`, `refresh(refresh_token) -> access_token`, `list_locations(token) -> [{name: "locations/<id>", title, address, new_review_uri}]`, `patch_hours(token, location_name, regular_hours, special_hours)`, `revoke(token)` | two locations `locations/sim-1`, `locations/sim-2`, review link `https://example.invalid/review/<id>`; stores patched hours, counts calls | D |
| `FortnoxClient` (`shared/fortnox.py`), `VismaClient` (`shared/visma.py`), same port `AccountingProviderClient` | `authorize_url(state, redirect_uri)`, `exchange_code(code, redirect_uri) -> Token{access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, company_id, org_number, company_name}`, `refresh(refresh_token) -> Token` (rotating), `post_voucher(token, Voucher{series, date, description, rows[{account, debit_ore, credit_ore, text, cost_center?}]}) -> Ref{id, series, number}`, `find_voucher(token, date, series, text_contains) -> Ref \| None`, `revoke(token)`; errors `account_missing`, `financial_year_missing`, `period_locked`, `unauthorized`, `rate_limited`, `unavailable` | in-memory company ledger, numbering per series; a used refresh token raises `unauthorized`; `missing_accounts={...}` and `org_number=` configurable | I |
| `TextModel` (`shared/bedrock.py`) | `complete(system, prompt, *, max_tokens, json_schema=None) -> str` | with `json_schema`: the smallest valid instance (strings "Simulerad text" cut to `maxLength`, arrays at `minItems`, enums first value); without: `"Simulerad text: " + prompt[:40]`; `responses=[...]` queues canned answers | A |
| `VoiceProvider` (`shared/voice_provider.py`, addendum) | `create_agent(config) -> provider_agent_id`, `update_agent(id, config)`, `delete_agent(id)`, `sip_target(id) -> SipTarget{uri, auth?}`, `say(call_ref, text)`, `transfer(call_ref, to_e164, timeout_s) -> TransferResult{answered}`, `end(call_ref, reason)`, `recording_url(call_ref) -> url \| None`, `parse_webhook(headers, body) -> list[VoiceEvent]` (`call_started`, `transcript`, `language_detected`, `interrupted`, `transfer_result`, `call_ended`); error `VoiceProviderError(code, retryable)` | ids `sim-agent-<sha1(name)[:10]>`, idempotent by name; `sip_target` = `sip:<id>@sim.invalid`; `say`/`transfer`/`end` recorded in `calls`; `transfer` answers per `transfer_answered=True\|False` set on the instance; `parse_webhook` accepts the simulator's own JSON (`{"events": [...]}`) with a `X-Sim-Signature: ok` header, anything else raises `unauthorized`; `recording_url` returns a `file://` fixture only when `recording=True` | L (real: `shared/voice_provider_real.py`, ElevenLabs) |
| `Telephony` (`shared/telephony.py`, addendum) | `provision_number(country, label) -> Number{e164, provider_id}`, `release_number(provider_id)`, `set_inbound(provider_id, sip, fallback_e164)`, `transfer(call_ref, to_e164, timeout_s) -> TransferResult`, `parse_webhook(headers, body) -> list[TelephonyEvent]` (`inbound`, `ended`), `verify_forwarding(e164) -> ForwardingCheck`; error `TelephonyError(code, retryable)` | numbers `+4610000<n:04d>` handed out in order, `numbers_left=0` makes `provision_number` raise `number_unavailable`; `set_inbound` stores the target per number; webhook auth = Basic `sim:sim`; `verify_forwarding` returns `unsupported` | L (real: `shared/telephony_real.py`, 46elks) |
| `AgentModel` (`shared/agent_model.py`, addendum) | `converse(system, messages, tools, *, max_tokens) -> Turn{text?, tool_uses[{id, name, input}], stop_reason}`; error `AgentModelError(code, retryable)` | **scripted intent table**: the last caller message is matched against Swedish and English patterns shipped with the simulator (book, availability, move, cancel, menu, hours, human, callback, yes, no, number, date, time, party size) and turned into the matching tool use or a fixed Swedish/English sentence; a `tool_result` message produces the confirmation sentence for that tool; `responses=[...]` overrides with canned turns; `delay_ms` sleeps to exercise the latency harness. **Counter-offers (2026-11-04, ADR-L decision 13):** a `hold_table` result `{held: false, ...}` produces the nearby-table sentence (first), else the `MAX_OFFERS = 3` closest same-day times on both sides (`nearest_times`: by distance, tie to the earlier time, spoken in clock order), else the next-day question; "yes" holds the nearby `tableIds`, asks for a time, or moves to the next day once (then offers a callback); "no" to a nearby table falls back to the times; the day the agent moved to stays the booked day until the caller names another, and a date the caller names starts the next-day count again (once per requested day); a `get_availability` result with `requestedTime` is spoken as "Närmast klockan ..." | L (real: `shared/agent_model_real.py`, Bedrock Converse stream) |

Terraform: each feature module sets the env var from the root variable for
the functions that use the client; `bedrock:InvokeModel` only on the
`bedrock_model_id` ARN; (addendum) `bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream`
only on the `phone_agent_model_id` ARN, from `phone-agent-call` and
`phone-agent` (simulate route).

## 15. OpenAPI

Each feature documents its JWT and public routes in its own fragment
`application/docs/openapi/<feature-id>.yaml` (`paths` and
`components.schemas` only; schema names prefixed with the feature in
PascalCase, e.g. `MetaAdsCampaign`). `tests/test_openapi.py` (Run 0) merges
`docs/openapi.yaml` with every fragment (duplicate path or schema = fail),
validates the merged document, and checks that each fragment documents
exactly the route keys in its handler's module-level
`ROUTES` dict (`functions/<feature-id>/app.py`, keys `"METHOD /path"`).
Operator routes are documented in Booqy Console, not here. Existing-route
changes (`giftCardCode`, insights margin fields, guest export `features`)
are made in `docs/openapi.yaml` by Run 0.

and re-runs `tests/test_contracts.py`. Field types use the 1.1
mini-language. Everything else in this file that says "(addendum)" follows
from these entries plus the Terraform, frontend and console tasks in

```yaml
  TicketStatus: [valid, checked_in, transferred, refunded, void]

      Ticket.Sold: {locationId: string, eventId: string, occurrenceId: string, orderId: string, qty: int, amountOre: int}
      Ticket.CheckedIn: {locationId: string, occurrenceId: string, ticketId: string}
      Ticket.Transferred: {locationId: string, occurrenceId: string, ticketId: string, newTicketId: string, kind: "enum[gift,resale]"}
      Ticket.Refunded: {locationId: string, occurrenceId: string, ticketId: string, amountOre: int, by: "enum[owner,cancellation]"}
    booqy.phone-agent:
      PhoneCall.Answered: {locationId: string, callId: string, language: "enum[sv,en]"}
      PhoneCall.Ended: {locationId: string, callId: string, durationSec: int, billedMinutes: int, outcome: "enum[booked,moved,cancelled,info,transferred,callback,abandoned,refused,error]", reservationId?: string, callbackId?: string}
      PhoneCall.Refused: {locationId: string, callId: string, reason: "enum[cap,kill_switch,hours,paused,entitlement]"}
      PhoneCallback.Requested: {locationId: string, callbackId: string, callId: string}
      PhoneCallback.Closed: {locationId: string, callbackId: string}
      PhoneMinutes.CapReached: {periodEnd: date, minutes: int, capMinutes: int}
      PhoneNumber.Provisioned: {locationId: string}
      PhoneNumber.Released: {locationId: string}

hooks:                          # changed and new entries only
  privacy.export:  {caller: guest-privacy, targets: [guest-crm, google-business, gift-cards, waitlist, events-tickets, phone-agent], gate: ever_on}
  privacy.erase:   {caller: guest-privacy, targets: [guest-crm, google-business, gift-cards, waitlist, events-tickets, phone-agent], gate: ever_on}
  tenant.purge:    {caller: tenant-purge, targets: [<all twelve feature ids>], gate: always}
  stripe.event:    {caller: stripe-webhook, targets: [gift-cards, events-tickets], gate: ever_on}   # target chosen by metadata.kind: giftcard | ticket
  accounting.events: {caller: accounting, targets: [gift-cards, events-tickets], gate: ever_on}
  insights.events: {caller: insights, targets: [events-tickets], gate: ever_on}   # staff see it too; without_money strips revenueOre (8.2, 9.2; DECISIONS.md 2026-11-02)
  billing.usage:   {caller: platform-tenants, targets: [phone-agent], gate: ever_on}
  platform:        {caller: platform-tenants, targets: [meta-ads, site-builder, google-business, personalliggare, phone-agent], gate: operator}

clients:
  voice:        {env: VOICE_CLIENT, tfvar: voice_client}
  telephony:    {env: TELEPHONY_CLIENT, tfvar: telephony_client}
  agent_model:  {env: AGENT_MODEL_CLIENT, tfvar: agent_model_client}

siteConfig:
  tenantFeatures: [..., events]          # existing five + giftCards, waitlist, siteBuilder, events

slots:
  admin:
    bokningar.panel.callbacks:   {feature: phoneAgent, ownerOnly: false, host: BokningarPage}
    bokningar.reservation.call:  {feature: phoneAgent, ownerOnly: false, host: BokningarPage}
    statistik.events:            {feature: events, ownerOnly: false, host: StatistikPage}
  console:
    tenant.integrations.phoneAgent: {feature: phoneAgent, host: TenantPage Integrations tab}
    settings.phoneAgent:            {feature: null, host: SettingsPage}   # platform-wide page, no tenant features (same as settings.metaAds)

storage:
  siteKit:
    TICKET_PURCHASE_KEY: {key: booqy-ticket-purchase, kind: sessionStorage, feature: events}
  admin:
    EVENT_SCAN_KEY_PREFIX: {key: "booqy-event-scan-<occurrenceId>", kind: IndexedDB, feature: events}

consoleForwardOps:
  phone-agent.tenant.get:    {route: L15, target: phone-agent, audit: null}
  phone-agent.tenant.pause:  {route: L16, target: phone-agent, audit: [phone_agent_paused, phone_agent_resumed]}
  phone-agent.settings.get:  {route: L17, target: phone-agent, audit: null}
  phone-agent.settings.put:  {route: L18, target: phone-agent, audit: phone_agent_settings_changed}
```

### 17.1 Counter-offer additions (2026-11-04, ADR-L decision 13; on `dev` via the `claude/spec-*` PRs)

```yaml
events:
  sources:
    booqy.phone-agent:
      PhoneCall.Ended: {..., counterOffer?: "enum[none,other_time,next_day,nearby_table]"}

enums:
  CounterOffer: [none, other_time, next_day, nearby_table]
```

`application/shared/contracts.py` gains the `CounterOffer` Literal, the
optional `counterOffer` on `PhoneCallEndedDetail` and `EVENTS`; the two
TypeScript targets that emit enums (`admin-front-end/src/shared/contracts.ts`
and `booqy-console/web/src/contracts.ts`) gain the `CounterOffer` type and
their new `CONTRACTS_HASH`; the console API (`booqy-console/api/src/app/contracts.py`)
and site-kit (`customer-front-end/packages/site-kit/src/shared/contracts.ts`)
change only their `CONTRACTS_HASH` line. All five are regenerated in the
same change so `--check` stays clean.

The generator's detail-type pattern already accepts every name above
(`Published`, `Cancelled`, `Sold`, `CheckedIn`, `Transferred`, `Refunded`,
`Answered`, `Ended`, `Refused`, `Requested`, `Closed`, `CapReached`,
`Provisioned`, `Released`). The `storage` section gains an `admin` map
(today it has only site-kit keys); the generator emits the admin constant
into `admin-front-end/src/shared/contracts.ts` as `STORAGE_KEYS` and the
admin registry imports it. The self-consistency test must still pass:
every new source is `booqy.<feature-id>`, every hook target and slot
feature is a known id/key, no duplicate keys.
